verdict.rationale: Cake documents its own MCP integration that lets Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client query the live cap table in plain English, covering shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes. However, the docs state it is "All read-only", so natural language can query the product but cannot operate it (no issuing grants, recording transactions, or running workflows). missing for 10: write/action capabilities via natural language, coverage of operational workflows beyond querying, independent or hands-on corroboration.
